# Native TagLib

Unmodified TagLib 2.3.2 source from https://taglib.org/releases/taglib-2.3.2.tar.gz.
SHA256: 3ca2d8afaa7f1cf7f6ed10e511ebc368bfacd6dcaa3dbfa690b89e502e8963dc.

The native metadata fallback statically links this source for formats not handled
by Lofty. Select the LGPL-2.1-or-later license from TagLib's dual-license terms;
see COPYING.LGPL. Build instructions and the complete source allow relinking.
